title.zh: EU Regulator Says Prediction Markets Are 'Rife With Inside Trading'
title.en: EU Regulator Says Prediction Markets Are 'Rife With Inside Trading'

current_state.zh: The EU's ESMA warned that prediction markets are 'rife with inside trading,' citing insider trading, manipulation and retail harm while noting the platforms have gained little EU traction due to binary options rules, in contrast to the more permissive U.S. approach.
